posts.title: Can AI chair a multilateral negotiation? I gave eleven models the job
posts.description: The ranking does not follow the price or reputation of the model, one low-cost Chinese model matched Claude Opus 5.5 and Grok 4.7, while one of Google's flagship models reached an agreement in less than half its attempts.

posts.title: 60 years of Malta at the UN General Assembly
posts.description: Every September, Malta's prime minister or foreign minister takes to New York. I decided to bring together all of Malta's general debate speeches since independence, to see how what the country speaks about has changed.
